raw_text:
Independent review of r-20261005T125215313502-ped-timeout-worldmodel at head d56f74b8 against base adb67e5f (plan imas-ambix:project-environment-declared §5, "Triage the tests the 300 s bound reaches"). Read the reviewed run's two commits bfa42c01 (test mark) and d56f74b8 (fragment), its manifest and its gate logs under logs/. The reviewed worktree was clean at the head; this review changed nothing in it. The change is a test-file mark plus one evidence fragment, 29 insertions across exactly the two declared paths.

Independently verified in this reviewer's own reading: the fragment's seven test ids are exactly the seven tests/worldmodel rows in the abort table of docs/evidence/fragments/project-environment-declared/ped-declare-relock.html (that table's 37 rows include seven worldmodel rows and no more; tests/worldmodel/test_rssm.py::test_overfit_smoke_camera_ce_drops is at 298.61 s in the slowest-tests list, was not aborted, and is correctly out of this node's scope). Every measured duration in the fragment reconciles with the reviewed run's own measurement logs (skeleton.log 539.79 s and 186.71 s, ctl_actuator 39.86 s, ctl_gate 23.59 s, st_model 38.91 s, st_v2 42.44 s, timescale 28.07 s), and each row's recorded load matches that log's header.

The mark arithmetic is correct: 2 x 539.79 = 1079.58, rounded up to a multiple of 60 = 1080, and the mark's comment states the measurement. The negative control removes the mark and runs at the default bound: negctl_real_shot_default300.log ends FAILED tests/worldmodel/test_worldmodel_skeleton.py::test_real_shot_overfit_smoke with "Failed: Timeout (>300.0s) from pytest-timeout.", EXIT=1 -- the guard fires. This review independently reproduced the passing head arm: at head d56f74b8 the marked test ran at the default bound and passed, 556.66 s call (620.68 s wall), EXIT=0, load1 41.0 (indep_rerun.log), so the mark is what carries the default invocation past 300 s. The reviewed run's own five confirm logs at the default bound each pass (skeleton 9 passed, controllable 53, st_model 14, st_v2 12, timescale 23), all EXIT=0.
